title: Why Your Phone Ignores Gloves But Feels Your Finger #shorts
description:
Your screen never feels pressure — it feels stolen electric charge. Here's the hidden grid that decides what counts as a touch.
⚡ A grid of invisible electrodes under the glass
🔢 Why every crossing point holds about 2 picofarads
👆 How your finger steals charge and drops that number
🧤 Why insulating gloves leave the reading untouched
📡 How the controller scans 60 times a second to find you
